scripts.install:all: npm.cmd install --prefix server && npm.cmd install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "DB,SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow,cyan,magenta" "npm.cmd run dev:db --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix server" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm.cmd run lint --prefix server && npm.cmd run lint --prefix client
scripts.test: npm.cmd run test --prefix server && npm.cmd run test --prefix client
